# Fatih Demirsoy – Google Workspace email migration

> Fatih Demirsoy is a network and systems administrator who migrates company email to Google Workspace from Yandex 360, cPanel/Plesk hosting mail, Microsoft 365 and other IMAP providers. Fixed prices, fully remote, with a per-mailbox email count report at handover that shows nothing went missing.

## Service
- Included: Workspace account setup and domain verification; user creation; admin security (2-step verification, password policy); MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC setup and testing; migration of all old email with folders plus a final sync; a per-mailbox count report comparing the old system with Workspace; 7 days of support.
- Priced separately: Outlook setup, moving files to Drive, group and alias changes after the switch, training, monthly management.
- Typical duration 1–3 days. The old system stays on until the migration is verified, so no email is lost.
- The customer owns the main admin account and pays the Google Workspace licence directly to Google.
- Payment: half at the start, half on the day the MX record is switched. International customers: bank transfer or Payoneer (Payoneer is not available to residents of Russia and Belarus).
- Languages: Turkish, English, Indonesian, Azerbaijani, German, French, Swedish, Russian.

## Prices
- Türkiye (TRY, VAT excluded): setup including 5 users 4000 TL; each additional user 350 TL; additional domain 1000 TL; Outlook setup 250 TL per user; monthly management 1500 TL per month.
- International (USD): setup including 5 users $80; each additional user $7; additional domain $20; Outlook setup $5 per user; monthly management $30 per month.

## Reference project
- 2 domains and 38 mailboxes merged into one Workspace account, migrated from Yandex 360. The migration tool reported one mailbox as completed while 4,400 emails were missing; the count check caught it before handover.
